Pt_1287

Pelliot tib tain 1287
    photo
1. Content : Old Tibetan Chronicle.
2. Note : Scroll. The end is missing. Recto, 536 lines. Verso, Chinese Buddhist texts. Cf. Catalogue VI (96-100). Similar to IOL Tib J 1375.
3. References :
Choix II (pls. 557-578, notice 21-23, 25-31), Choix III (17-39) [I.Translit.].
Lalou (1939-1961: III, 2) [P.Translit.], Bacot et al. (1940-1946: 93-170) [I.Translit., I.Trans.], Róna-Tas (1955) [ P.Translit., P.Trans.], Satō (1958-1959: 171, 175-6 et passim.) [P.Translit., P.Trans.], Uray (1962: 229-230) [ P.Translit., P.Trans.], Petech (1968), Uray (1968), Haarh (1969: 401-406) [P.Translit., P.Trans.], Uray (1972) [P.Translit., P.Trans.], Bogoslovskij (1972: 31, 36 et passim.), Beckwith (1977: 177-258) [P.Translit., P.Trans.], Moriyasu (1984: 21-22, 29, 57) [P.Translit., P.Trans.], Yamaguchi (1985: 458-462, 463-466, 466-476, 485-489) [P.Translit., P.Trans.], Beckwith (1987: 11, 13 et passim.) [P.Translit., P.Trans.], Stein (1987: 176-182) [P.Trans.], Uray (1988: 1503), Wang and Chen (1992: 34-66, 112-141, 157-172) [I.Translit., I.Trans.], Gnya' gong (1995: 16-108, 361-402) [P.Translit.], Huang and Ma (2000: 140-151, 156-295) [I.Translit., I.Trans.], Hill (2006) [P.Translit., P.Trans.], Zeisler (2011)[P.Trans.].

Transliteration   (Change the Display Format)

(1) $ /:/ drI gum btsan po sku chung ba 'I tshe mtshan jIr gdags shes / / ma ma gro zha ma skyi brling ma la drIs na / ma ma 'I mchid nas /
(2) skyI brag mar ba nI rnyil tam ma rnyil / dang ma 'bri spangs nI myes tshig gam ma tshIg / mtsho dam le dbal mtsho ni skams
(3) sam ma skams shes mchi / brag ma rnyIl / mtsho yang ma skams spang yang myes ma tshig ces bgyisnabgyis na / ma ma gro zha
(4) ma / rgas nas rna log par thos ste / brag kyang rnyil / spang yang myes tshig / mtsho yang skams shes thos nas / /
(5) 'on tang chu dgum sri dgum gyIs / drI gum btsan por mtshan thog shig ches mchi nas / / drI gum btsan
(6) por mtshan btags nas / mtshan btags nongstenongs te / thugs su yang zhugs / lde sras myI 'i myi tshul te / mngon
(7) bar dgung du gshegs pa la stsogs pa 'phrul dang byIn ched po mnga' bas / drod dang dregs ma thub ste / / btsan
(8) 'dran bda' nas / yab 'bangs pha dgu' dang / yum 'bangs tshan gsum la dgra ru rgal g.yag du drung
(9) phod dam zhes bka' stsal na / so so nas kun gyis myI phod ches gsol to / lo ngam rta rdzis kyang myi phod
(10) ces gsol pa las ma gnang ste / / 'ung nas lo ngam gyIs gsol pa / de ltar myI gnang na / lha 'i dkor
(11) mdung rang 'debs dang / ral gyIgrI rang gcod dang / khrab rang gyon dang / phub rang bzur la stsogs pa / 'phrul gyi dkor
(12) ched po mnga' ba 'I rnams bdag la stsal na phod ces gsol to / de nas lha 'I dkor tham shad stsal to /
